diagnostics.description: Inspect counts and status needed for recovery without changing stored data.
diagnostics.copyFailed: Diagnostics were collected but could not be copied. Select “Copy collected diagnostics” to try again.

recoveryPlan.description: Read the remaining note content and distillation history to compare recovery sources. No data is changed.
recoveryPlan.copyFailed: The comparison was collected but could not be copied. Select “Copy collected comparison” to try again.

ai.name: AI app (Claude)
ai.desc: Set up AI access to search and record knowledge. Registration and observed use are shown separately.
ai.done: Connection settings saved. Restart Claude Desktop and reconnect kb-app MCP.

smartSearch.name: Smart search
smartSearch.desc: Finds notes by meaning, even when the wording differs. Just turn it on — nothing leaves your machine (a one-time ~560MB download).
smartSearch.preparing: Setting up smart search… (this takes a few minutes)

backup.name: Backup
backup.desc: Back up notes and files marked for full sync to a private repository, then restore them on your other devices. Local-only files never leave this device.
backup.done: Backup destination set, and the first copy has been sent

clients.title: AI app registration and activity
clients.description: Register an AI app, then inspect its settings and observed activity.

outputStates.not_observed: No output record with a verified rule version
outputStates.different_rules: Last output differs from current rules
outputStates.concurrent_outputs: Mixed outputs at the same time; order unverified

issues.missing_config: The AI app configuration file is missing.
issues.missing_server: Some purpose-specific MCP registrations are missing.
issues.vault_mismatch: A different knowledge base is registered.
issues.client_mismatch: The registration is for another AI app.
issues.arguments_mismatch: The MCP launch settings differ from the current format.
issues.invalid_config: The configuration format could not be read. Check settings in the AI app.
issues.unreadable_config: The configuration file could not be read. Check its permissions.
issues.managed_policy_conflict: The registration conflicts with managed settings. Contact your administrator.
issues.managed_policy_unverified: The effect of managed settings is unverified. Contact your administrator.
issues.scoped_override: Project or other scoped settings override registration. Check those settings in the AI app.
issues.unsafe_path: This configuration location cannot be updated safely. Check settings in the AI app.
issues.unsupported_platform: Automatic registration and repair are unavailable on this OS.
issues.tool_policy_restriction: Available MCP tools are restricted by configuration. Review the required tool permissions in the AI app.

clients.protectionHint: Review and configure protection in Knowledge base access.
clients.registered: Registration saved. Restart the AI app and reconnect MCP.
clients.reconnect: Restart {{client}} and reconnect kb-app MCP, then select Check all again. Checking settings alone cannot confirm that reconnection is complete.
clients.evidenceNote: Registered means the configuration matches. Output records describe the last hook output; save and update counts describe MCP responses. Neither confirms a current connection, receipt of rules, or AI compliance. Project and launch-time overrides are detected only where they can be inspected.
clients.knowledgeBaseDetails: Knowledge base, vocabulary source, and OS details
clients.capabilitySummary: Separate search, save, and maintenance registrations
clients.supportedOs: Automatic registration and protection configuration support macOS. Availability on other operating systems must be checked separately.
